chunks: Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hisham ibn Salim, who said:

We sent to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, while we were a group in al-Madinah, that we wished to bid you farewell. So Abu Abdullah عليه السلام sent to us: “Perform ghusl in al-Madinah, for I fear that water may become scarce for you at Dhi al-Hulayfah. So perform ghusl in al-Madinah, wear your garments in which you will enter ihram, then come, one by one and two by two.”
He said: We gathered before him, and Ibn Abi Ya‘fur said to him: “What do you say regarding oiling after ghusl for ihram?” He said: “Before, after, and with it, there is no harm in it.”

He said: Then he called for a bottle of bān salīkhah, in which there was nothing, and he instructed us, so we anointed ourselves from it. Then when we intended to leave, he said: “There is no blame upon you to perform ghusl if you find water when you reach Dhi al-Hulayfah.”

key_terms.بَأْسٌ: Harm or objection, negated here to indicate permissibility.
key_terms.ثِيَابَكُمُ: Your garments, referring to the clothes to be worn for entering ihram.
key_terms.دُهْنَةٍ: Oiling or anointing, asked about in relation to preparation for ihram.
key_terms.ذِي ٱلْحُلَيْفَةِ: Dhi al-Hulayfah, the miqat location mentioned where water might be scarce.
key_terms.مَاءً: Water, relevant to the possibility of repeating ghusl at Dhi al-Hulayfah.
key_terms.ٱغْتَسِلُوا: Perform ghusl, the ritual bath commanded here before ihram.
key_terms.ٱلْإِحْرَامِ: Ihram, the consecrated state for hajj or 'umrah for which these preparations are made.
key_terms.ٱلْمَدِينَةِ: Al-Madinah, the place where the group was instructed to prepare before departure.

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about ghusl and applying oil before entering ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses preparation for ihram before reaching Dhi al-Hulayfah, including performing ghusl in al-Madinah due to possible lack of water on the route. It also indicates the permissibility of applying oil in connection with the ghusl for ihram and allows repeating the ghusl at Dhi al-Hulayfah if water is available.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2537 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hisham ibn Salim, who said:
We, a group in Medina, sent a message to Abu Abdullah (as), informing him that we wanted to bid him farewell. Abu Abdullah (as) sent back a reply:
"Perform ghusl (ritual bath) in Medina, for I fear that water may be scarce for you at Dhul-Hulayfah. Perform ghusl in Medina, wear the clothes you intend to enter Ihram in, and then come to me individually or in pairs."
We gathered at his place, and Ibn Abi Ya‘fur asked him: "What do you say about using oil after the ghusl for Ihram?"
Imam (as) replied: "Whether before, after, or during (Ihram), there is no harm in it."
Then, Imam (as) brought a bottle of bān salīkhah (a type of oil) that was empty except for a small amount, and he instructed us to apply it.
When we were ready to leave, Imam (as) said:
"It is not necessary, but if you find water upon reaching Dhul-Hulayfah, you may perform ghusl again."
